text_block_list.text:
Tonight,
I'd be attending a party together with
Symboli Kris S. 
It was a party held at the same time as the
Summer Training camp――

text_block_list.name: Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the 『Racing Promotional
Exchange』. 
Symboli Kris S-sama and one guest. Please,
come aboard.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Yeah. 
A learning―― experience.
――Every little bit helps.

――At the party,
there were many notable faces that 
were involved in the Uma Musume Racing
world.

Famous trainers with many accolades to their
name……the 
author of a book on racing theory that could
be 
called mandatory reading……and so on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me 
――those two glasses on the right.

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Understood. 
……Please enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer. ……Here.

She took the initiative and acted as
escort. 
Maybe she's used to these kinds of
places――

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text:
And so―― Cheers! 
Everyone, please enjoy the festivities.

text_block_list.name: Race Official
text_block_list.text:
――You're,
Symboli Kris S-san right?
The rumors weren't an 
exaggeration.
That race the other day was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. 
――It's an honor.

text_block_list.name: Race Official
text_block_list.text: ……Fufu, the cool-type I see.

text_block_list.name: Race Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I'm researching the best methods to train
Uma Musumes. I'd love 
to hear about the experiences of a first-class
runner like you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Sure. 
……I don't mind.

Symboli Kris S was approached by attendees
one after the other. 
I decided to watch over her while she mingled
for now.

――The number of people approaching her had
finally died down. 
After all that talking,
she probably wanted something to drink.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Oh…… It's already this late? 
――Well then, give me your hand.

Symboli Kris S grabbed my hand and took me
to the cafe area. 
Most of the attendees were on the deck,
so there were few people.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――If it's here…… we can sit down.

The summer sky that was visible from the
ship was expansive, 
clear,
and brilliant.
That brilliance was just like――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ? ……――What's――so funny?
choice_data_list: I'm glad the party seemed fun

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ―――――Seemed fun……?
choice_data_list: Your eyes were shining like these ...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――The party today…… is an important
place. 
A place necessary――to fulfill my mission.
choice_data_list: But that's not the only thing, right?
But that's not the only thing, right?

text_block_list.text:
I had come to understand her.
She wasn't defined 
by just her mission…… She could find purpose
and enjoyment in her own way.
At that time too――
『Looks like we found its purpose』
『Looks like we found its purpose』

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
……That's good. ――……I think…… 
…………that too.

Unsold goods――She was glad we had found
their purpose.
You could read her emotions just by 
noticing the slight changes in her
demeanor.

Particularly today,
she seemed to be in high spirits. 
She was proactive and had listened intently
to 
each attendee that had spoken to her――
choice_data_list: It seemed like you were having fun

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Listening to the pros…… I learned a
lot. 
Cutting-edge information―― was useful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I need to figure out…… how to use that―― 
information in the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So that next time―― I know what to ask――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――――……Exciting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So I was………… thrilled?――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: You're………… amazing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: You―― understand my…… emotions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Those emotions―― that I can't put in to
words. 
……Even those emotions―― that I don't―― really
understand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This―― excitement……

Symboli Kris S,
who had desperately been searching 
for the words,
suddenly looked directly at me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: For me, that is――――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
…………Nevermind. ――-If it's you, 
you understand…… feelings like these……

The corners of her eyes seemed to soften as
she looked straight 
at me―― that sparkle,
it really did seem like the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But… 
――……Why is it? …………how do you know……?

Symboli Kris S tilted her head slightly. 
Seeing that slightly child-like expression,
I couldn't help it――
choice_data_list: You see, I can read minds

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――――……Hmmm. 
……that's―― amazing, huh.

The corners of her mouth raised
slightly…… 
It seems like she realized I was joking.
choice_data_list: I can tell just by watching you
I can tell just by watching you

text_block_list.text:
Communicating without words.
What she's feeling, 
what she desires, what stirs her heart――

I had sworn to be the one closest to her, 
and to understand her the most.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――――Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see. That's―― great――
